cohort: The study included 152 women (76 PPH cases and 76 controls) from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Advanced maternal age, preterm birth, cesarean delivery, and multiparity were significantly associated with PPH, with uterine atony accounting for most cases.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with PPH and independently predicted advanced interventions, obstetric hysterectomy, and blood transfusion.
